title: AFD deployment config
description: Generalized description of a P2pNcclAFDConnector recipe (recipe/gpu/P2pNcclAFDConnector/**), consumed by .agents/skills/deploy-afd-k8s/deploy/generate_recipe.py to produce a recipe .sh (plus a manifest) that the deploy-afd-k8s skill deploys.

name.description: Used to name generated files, ConfigMaps, and labels. Must be a valid k8s name segment.

family.description: Recipe directory name this config generalizes, e.g. 'deepseek_v2_lite'. Used only for labeling.

model_id.description: HF Hub repo id (e.g. 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite') or a literal in-container path (e.g. '/models/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8') matching the recipe's own MODEL_PATH convention.

extra_serve_args.description: Model-specific fixed vllm serve flags, keyed by flag name without leading '--'. Boolean true emits a bare flag (e.g. {"language-model-only": true} -> --language-model-only); any other value emits '--flag value'. Preserves insertion order.

strategy.description: prefill_decode_disaggregation is out of scope for deploy-afd-k8s (see SKILL.md Scope) and is intentionally not representable here.

afd_enabled.description: false generates a baseline (non-AFD) recipe: a single DP/TP group with no --additional-config, using the 'attention' block below as the sole group.

num_attention_ranks.description: Required when afd_enabled is true. Must equal attention.data_parallel_size * attention.tensor_parallel_size.

num_ffn_ranks.description: Required when afd_enabled is true. Must equal ffn.data_parallel_size * ffn.tensor_parallel_size. Must divide num_attention_ranks evenly, with num_attention_ranks >= num_ffn_ranks.

node_mode.description: single: attention+ffn in one recipe.sh / one Pod (today's behavior). multi: attention and ffn each get their own recipe.sh / Pod, scheduled on different nodes. multi requires afd_enabled=true. Experimental -- see SKILL.md caveat.

cudagraph_capture_size.description: Required when mode is 'graph'. Emitted as both --max-cudagraph-capture-size and the single entry of --compilation-config's cudagraph_capture_sizes.
